name: Hunter’s Spring (Combat)
body:
Rise to the occasion.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, Rising Hunter Style, Fly 3 ranks

Benefits: While using this style, you may spend a swift action to move 10 feet into the air if you are on the ground, or to move 5 feet in any direction if you are airborne. If this movement would put you adjacent to an airborne opponent, you may make an unarmed strike against that opponent as a free action. This is in addition to your normal movement and provokes an attack of opportunity from a creature if you leave that creature’s threatened area.

Special: This feat’s benefit applies to light weapons, ranged weapons, and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
